subject: [PATCH v2 3/8] nfsd: move the control plane to a per-namespace mutex

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch moves the control plane of the NFS daemon (nfsd) to a per-namespace mutex, allowing for concurrent operations across different network namespaces. The global nfsd_mutex is retained only for host-wide serialization, such as user refcounts and resource management. The change improves performance by reducing contention between namespaces and allows for more efficient handling of dynamic-thread autoscaling and RPC_STATUS_GET dumps.
